sum: Scans an agent skill before it is installed, looking for prompt injection, exfiltration paths, malicious patterns and supply-chain risk, and reports whether it is safe to install.

evidence.co.standards: cites standards_conformance.evidence: conforms to 2 of the 5 neutral interface standards (MCP, Agent Skills)
evidence.se.residency: cites data_residency: local-first, the operator's state stays on their machine
evidence.se.threats: cites th and ctrl: T17 introduced, controls prov impl, approval part, log part
evidence.sf.reach: restates exec and ctrl: the entry does not execute on its own, and approval is part
evidence.fx.exit: artifact.format markdown: Markdown, which any editor already reads
evidence.pe.budget: a ceiling the operator sets in configuration: src/skillspector/cli.py (max_depth:)
evidence.co.coexist: states the hosts it sits beside: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI (README.md)
evidence.ic.help: a command-line parser that prints its own usage: pyproject.toml (click)
evidence.ic.error: documented only, nothing in the code checks: README.md (human-in-the-loop)
evidence.se.attest: asks the operator to verify, without producing an attestation: README.md (verify the signature)
evidence.fx.install: an install that does not change the machine globally: README.md (uv tool install)
evidence.fx.byo: the provider is the operator's choice: ANTHROPIC, OLLAMA, VLLM, LLAMA.CPP, OPENAI, BEDROCK (README.md)

pre: skills arriving from somewhere you do not control
a place in the install path where a gate can stand
anti: judging whether a skill is any good, which a security scan does not decide
environments where every skill is written in-house and reviewed already
gnote: The only entry here whose subject is the supply chain of skills rather than of code, which matters because a skill is executed instructions. Its own README states the figures behind it: 26.1% of scanned skills carried vulnerabilities and 5.2% showed likely malicious intent.

ja.sum: エージェントスキルを導入前に走査し、プロンプトインジェクション・情報持ち出し経路・悪意あるパターン・サプライチェーン上の危険を検出して、入れて安全かを報告する。
pre: 自分の管理外から来るスキル
導入経路上にゲートを置ける場所
anti: スキルの出来の良し悪しの判定。セキュリティ走査はそれを決めない
全スキルを内製しレビュー済みの環境
ja.gnote: 対象がコードではなくスキルのサプライチェーンである唯一のツール。スキルは実行される指示なので、これは重要な差である。README自身が根拠の数字を出している。走査したスキルの26.1%に脆弱性、5.2%に悪意の疑いがあった。

steps: アナライザを並列実行
